title: just chill
description: It's a laid-back survival game with friendly mobs—no enemies, just you and the game's soundtrack
body:
# just chill

**just chill** is a Minecraft 1.21.1 (NeoForge) modpack designed for players who want a relaxing, stress-free survival experience. No hostile mobs. No PvP pressure. Just you, a beautiful world, and the freedom to explore and build at your own pace.

---

## Why download just chill?

Vanilla Minecraft can feel intense — hostile mobs at every turn, tedious resource gathering, and visuals that don't do justice to the world you're building. **just chill** solves all of that:

- **No enemies** — PassiveMobs replaces all hostile creatures with friendly ones. You'll never be attacked.
- **A world worth exploring** — Terralith, Geophilic, Ecologics, Naturalist, and the entire YUNG's suite overhaul every biome, cave, and structure in the game.
- **Visuals that take your breath away** — Iris Shaders ships with 7 shader packs (Complementary Reimagined, BSL, Rethinking Voxels, Bliss, Photon, MakeUp Ultra Fast, I Like Vanilla), alongside Fresh Animations, Sound Physics Remastered, Particle Rain, and AmbientSounds.
- **Smooth performance** — Sodium, Lithium, ImmediatelyFast, and Entity Culling ensure the pack runs well even with shaders on.
- **Multiplayer ready** — Play solo or host a server for friends. Everything works client- and server-side.

---

## What does this modpack add?

### 🌍 World Generation
- **Terralith** — 100+ new biomes and dramatically improved terrain.
- **Geophilic** — Subtle, natural improvements to vanilla biomes.
- **Ecologics** — New wildlife and features in existing biomes.
- **Naturalist** — Real-world animals populating the world.
- **YUNG's Better Caves, Dungeons, Strongholds, Mineshafts, Desert Temples, Jungle Temples, Witch Huts, Ocean Monuments, Nether Fortresses, End Island, Bridges & Extras** — Every structure and underground system completely redesigned.
- **Lithostitched** — Ensures seamless compatibility between worldgen mods.

### 🏕️ Peaceful Survival & Gameplay
- **PassiveMobs** — All hostile mobs replaced by passive ones.
- **Farmer's Delight** — Expanded farming and cooking with new crops, meals, and tools.
- **Sophisticated Backpacks** — Upgradeable backpacks to carry more loot.
- **Comforts** — Sleeping bags and hammocks to rest anywhere.
- **Waystones** — Fast travel between discovered waypoints.
- **VeinMiner** — Mine entire ore veins instantly.
- **FallingTree** — Chop down whole trees in one swing.
- **Immersive Aircraft** — Craftable, animated aircraft to fly across your world.
- **Sit** — Sit on any stair or slab.

### 🎨 Visuals & Atmosphere
- **Iris Shaders** with 7 included shader packs.
- **Particle Rain** — Realistic rain and snow particles.
- **Sound Physics Remastered** — Environmental reverb and echo.
- **AmbientSounds** — Biome-specific ambient soundscapes.
- **[ETF] Entity Texture Features & [EMF] Entity Model Features** — Randomized and enhanced mob visuals.
- **Fresh Animations + Extensions** — Fluid, lively mob animations.
- **Continuity** — Connected textures for glass and more.
- **Resource packs:** Default Dark Mode, New Glowing Ores, Detailed Animations, Clean Connected Glass, Connected Paths, Low On Fire, (Bee's) Fancy Crops.

### ⚡ Performance
- **Sodium, Lithium, ImmediatelyFast, Entity Culling** — Major rendering and game logic optimizations.

### 🛠️ Quality of Life
- **Just Enough Items (JEI)** — In-game recipe browser.
- **Jade** — Block and entity tooltips on hover.
- **BetterF3** — Clean, color-coded debug screen.
- **Just Zoom** — Simple zoom keybind.
- **Mouse Tweaks** — Improved inventory mouse controls.
- **Controlling** — Searchable keybind menu.
- **Chat Animation** — Smooth animated chat messages.
- **spark** — Performance profiler.
- **Crash Assistant** — Friendly crash report analyzer.

---
